title: Area-code shard C pass 19 — 557 / 563 / 572
summary: Bounded shard-C area-code enumeration covering current U.S. geographic NPAs 557, 563, and 572 with public-role person cross-enumeration.

provenance.method: area-code and locality public-source enumeration with public-role person cross-enumeration

data.research_question: Which current public organizations, communications surfaces, and publicly identifiable organizational-role people can be verified in the next unresolved shard-C U.S. geographic NPAs 557, 563, and 572?
data.method: Current NANPA geographic admission, deterministic NPA mod 3 == 2 sharding, literal and locality-derived public-source searches, historical-directory discovery only, current-status verification, repository dedupe, public identifier enumeration, and public-role person cross-enumeration.
classification_rules: Historical directories are discovery seeds only; current-status verification is required before calling an organization active.
Do not infer individual political affiliation from organizational role, participation, proximity, attendance, volunteering, membership, or public representation.
Do not merge people or organizations from name or handle similarity alone.
Overlay locality relations for 557/572 are geographic discovery relations and do not assert an organization publishes that NPA unless directly evidenced.
Existing canonical organizations and investigation targets are reused rather than duplicated.
Person-org relations in this pass are explicit public organizational roles or public event representation; no inferred relation is promoted.

findings.notes: STL Mutual Aid is reused from the existing 314 record and reverified through its first-party About page; Solidarity Economy St. Louis is newly materialized. Julia Ho is explicitly sourced as founder of Solidarity Economy St. Louis and co-founder of STL Mutual Aid; Erica Williams, Marcus Hunt and Carmen Ward are first-party-named STL Mutual Aid organizers. NPA 557 overlays 314.

Quad Cities DSA and Quad Cities Interfaith are current. QCDSA publishes an active mutual-aid working group, public email and member Discord-access request surface. Quad Cities Interfaith publishes a Davenport office, phone and email; Henry Marquard is retained from 2024 filing-derived public personnel data with explicit recency uncertainty.

Oklahoma City DSA and its Mutual Aid Working Group are reused from existing canonical 405 records and reverified through current first-party pages. Jennifer Gillispie is explicitly identified as organizer/contact for a 2026 public event sponsored by the Mutual Aid Working Group. 'Cooperation OKC' appears only as a venue label in this bounded pass and remains an unresolved organization-identity lead. NPA 572 overlays 405.

data.narrative_role: bounded area-code organization enumeration pass with public-role person cross-enumeration
